text:
Grace Kim: need to lock A/B params for quant kernels today so I can kick off the H100 runs + prep a small hosted canary. specifically:
- flags (force kernel family, logging)
- cohort definition
- rollback plan / kill switch
Can folks chime in with what we’re comfortable shipping behind a flag?

Noah Patel: +1. Let’s keep the experiment narrow. I’d prefer we A/B ONLY kernel family selection, not scheduler changes at the same time, otherwise attribution gets messy.

Rina Kobayashi: from harness side I can generate matrix if we standardize on 2 variants.
Variant A = current auto
Variant B = forced family (plus selector logging)
What’s the exact runtime flag name? I saw it in the PR but don’t want to guess.

Yuki Sato: in redwood PR 10629 the knob is:
`runtime.quant.force_kernel_family` (string) + `runtime.quant.force_kernel_family_scope` (default=per-op, can set to global)
Examples:
- `runtime.quant.force_kernel_family=fp8_attn_v2`
- `runtime.quant.force_kernel_family=int8_gemm_fused_v3`
If unset => normal auto-selector.
Also added `runtime.quant.emit_kernel_selection_spans=true` (but that has overhead; should be canary-only).

Connor O'Brien: can we avoid enabling spans in hosted canary? release eng is going to push back if we’re adding perf overhead during a perf experiment.
I’m ok with structured perf logs if they’re sampled.

Grace Kim: agreed. proposal:
- perf lab: spans ON (full fidelity)
- hosted canary: spans OFF, but structured perf log events ON w/ 1% sampling

Sahana Iyer: for gating we need determinism. perf-canary job can run with spans off, but must have kernel IDs in the logs so comparator can bucket by kernel family.
Can we set:
`runtime.perf_log.quant_kernel_id=true`
(or whatever the PR 10631 key is) and keep it at 100% for canary?

Yuki Sato: 10631 emits JSON perf events with `kernel_id`, `quant_mode`, `phase=prefill|decode`, `shapes` if `runtime.perf_log.json=true`.
We can keep it at 100% for canary *job* (nightly) and sample in hosted.

Marissa Cole: on cohort: do we want to do this in hosted at all during the sprint? I can set up a cohort in the rollout service but we need:
- which models
- regions
- %
- and a hard rollback switch.

Noah Patel: yes but only after perf-canary is green for 48h and we have correctness drift checks passing.
Cohort suggestion:
- start with 0% (dark launch; config only)
- then 0.5% of hosted traffic for 2 models, 1 region
- then 2% if no alerts

Sean Gallagher: pls keep hosted canary out of perf-lab nodes. we’ve had contention all week.
Also: if you do H100/H200 only, make sure the cohort filter is by GPU pool not just region, otherwise you’ll accidentally mix in A100 pods depending on capacity.

Marissa Cole: yup we can target by “capacity tier” tags (gpu_sku=H100) and by model route. I’ll need the exact tag values.

Grace Kim: model scope: top hosted chat models only. propose:
- `llama-3.1-70b-instruct` (high volume)
- `qwen2.5-32b-instruct` (good prefill mix)
Keep Mistral out for now.

Marcus Reed: do we include streaming chat metrics (TTFT/TPOT) in the hosted A/B readout? if yes, we should fix decoding params (temp/top_p/max_tokens) and ensure both variants get identical request params.

Rina Kobayashi: for benchmark suite we already pin decoding params. for hosted A/B we’ll have natural distribution.
Maybe define success as:
- p95 TTFT not worse than +3%
- p95 TPOT improves or flat
- tokens/sec improves >= +5%
But Connor will want rollback criteria.

Connor O'Brien: rollback criteria needs to be dead simple + automated.
For hosted canary, if ANY of these trigger for 15 min:
- p95 TTFT +5% vs control
- error rate +0.3% absolute
- correctness guardrail fires > N times (pick N)
Then auto-roll back to control.
Also: kill switch must be global, not per-model.

Sahana Iyer: I can add an allowlist + global kill switch in the rollout config:
- `quant_ab.enabled=false` kills all
- `quant_ab.models=[...]`
- `quant_ab.gpu_skus=[...]`
Then the runtime reads the assigned variant via header/metadata.

Yuki Sato: runtime side we already support `x-redwood-experiment` header -> variant mapping.
We can map:
- control: `force_kernel_family=` (unset)
- treatment: `force_kernel_family=fp8_attn_v2` (for FP8 mode) and `int8_gemm_fused_v3` (for INT8 mode)
Question: are we running FP8 and INT8 in the same hosted cohort? that’s 2D.

Noah Patel: let’s not do 2D in hosted. pick ONE mode for hosted canary.
Given the customer tickets lately, maybe do INT8 first? But the sprint is FP8+INT8.

Grace Kim: I’d rather do FP8 hosted first (more upside on H100/H200). INT8 we’ve got more shape corner cases + the selector bugfix is still baking.

Connor O'Brien: ok but then keep it H100 only and models that are known-good on FP8.
Also document rollback plan in release notes draft.

Sean Gallagher: +1 on H100-only. And please set cohort to us-west-2 only. us-east is running hot.

Marissa Cole: summarizing proposed hosted cohort:
- mode: FP8 only
- gpu_sku: H100
- region: us-west-2
- models: llama-3.1-70b-instruct, qwen2.5-32b-instruct
- start: 0.5% traffic for 2h, then 2% for 12h if clean
- auto rollback on Connor’s thresholds
Sound right?

Grace Kim: yes.
Treatment flag = `runtime.quant.force_kernel_family=fp8_attn_v2` (global scope ok?)

Yuki Sato: recommend scope=attention-only so we don’t accidentally change GEMM family.
Set:
`runtime.quant.force_kernel_family=fp8_attn_v2`
`runtime.quant.force_kernel_family_scope=attention`
Everything else stays auto.

Rina Kobayashi: perf lab A/B will still do full matrix (attn + gemm) via harness; hosted just attn.
I’ll update the experiment YAML generator to support scope.

Sahana Iyer: canary job config snippet (nightly) — pls confirm:
```
# control
runtime.quant.force_kernel_family=""
runtime.quant.force_kernel_family_scope=""
runtime.perf_log.json=true
runtime.quant.emit_kernel_selection_spans=false

# treatment
runtime.quant.force_kernel_family="fp8_attn_v2"
runtime.quant.force_kernel_family_scope="attention"
runtime.perf_log.json=true
runtime.quant.emit_kernel_selection_spans=false
```
We’ll get kernel_id from perf logs.

Noah Patel: looks good.
Also add a note: if kernel selection spans are enabled in perf lab, they MUST be off in hosted.

Connor O'Brien: rollback plan detail (write this down somewhere):
1) rollout service flips `quant_ab.enabled=false` (global)
2) runtime falls back to auto selector (control)
3) if still bad, flip `runtime.quant.mode=fp16` on the affected routes (second lever)
Marissa can you confirm step 2 propagates <5 min?

Marissa Cole: yes, config propagation is usually 1-2 min, worst case 5.
I’ll set a manual “big red button” as well.

Sean Gallagher: pls add a pre-check in the runbook: verify cluster tags are correct (gpu_sku label) before turning on cohort.
We had a label drift incident last month.

Grace Kim: :thumbsup: action items:
- Grace: post final params in ENG-24816 + update working doc
- Marissa: set up cohort in rollout svc w/ kill switch + rollback rules
- Sahana: update canary job config and thresholds for TTFT/TPOT + error rate
- Rina: harness generator update for scope + ensure logs include kernel_id
Let’s target enabling hosted 0.5% tomorrow morning *only if* tonight’s perf-canary is green.

Connor O'Brien: +1. please @ me before turning on hosted. I want to sanity check the rollback alert routing.

Rina Kobayashi: ack. will drop a link to the generated matrix once it’s in the repo.

Grace Kim: thanks all. I’ll paste the exact rollout config once Marissa has the cohort id.
